confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear pattern of account compromise and subsequent data exfiltration by user_09, followed by a separate pattern of suspicious cross-departmental data collection by user_04. Both users exhibited behaviors that deviate significantly from their baselines and roles.

attack_chain.description: Brute force attempt: Multiple failed login attempts for user_09 from an unusual IP (185.220.101.45).
Successful unauthorized login for user_09 from the suspicious IP.
Privilege escalation: user_09 successfully elevated their role permissions.
Bulk data exfiltration: user_09 performed a rapid series of 13 file downloads from the marketing directory.
Anti-forensics: user_09 deleted authentication logs to hide traces of the intrusion.
Secondary incident: user_04 (junior_accountant) began downloading sensitive files from HR, Legal, DevOps, and Executive directories, which are outside their normal finance scope.

gaps: Verification of whether user_04's actions were part of a legitimate (though poorly documented) cross-departmental audit.
Confirmation of whether the IP 185.220.101.45 is a known malicious/Tor exit node.
Information on whether user_09's role elevation was reverted or if the account was locked after the log deletion.
narrative: The environment suffered a successful account takeover of user_09, characterized by a brute-force attack, privilege escalation, bulk exfiltration of marketing data, and log deletion. Simultaneously, user_04 exhibited highly suspicious insider threat behavior by downloading sensitive files across multiple unauthorized departments (HR, Legal, DevOps, Executive).
